# Modular embedded preview fixture

Run `benchmark/jpegxl/generate-m6-preview.ts modular`, then the pinned
`benchmark/jpegxl/flush-progressive-oracle.ts` C API harness. Both images use
native Modular coding. The embedded image is 333 by 77 pixels and the main
image is 7 by 5 pixels. Exact independent outputs and provenance hashes are
recorded in the manifests. The analytical patterns and assembly are MIT licensed.
